scope: Every substantive citation-bearing sentence in the canonical manuscript, all six ordinary body-flow citation keys, all six canonical BibTeX entries, and bibliography coverage for problem context, closest prior work, verification methods, solver provenance, and the selected user-library methodology comparison.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage non-interactive audit: first freeze the smallest citation-bearing claims and their exact manuscript locations; then verify each claim independently against a primary publication record and exact nearby source passage, followed by BibTeX metadata and compiled-citation consistency checks.
